description:
Duplicate a widget of an SEO Reporting report once per entry of copies, changing only the filter — the way to repeat the same chart for many Smart Views or tags in ONE call. WRITE action — requires the write scope. Each copy keeps the source widget's type, metric and period, and is appended at the end of the report in the order given. Each entry takes viewId (Smart View, from list_smart_views) OR tags (+ tagType page|keyword) and an optional title (default: the view/tag name). An entry with no filter is a plain copy that keeps the source's filters. Everything is validated before anything is written: if any entry is invalid, or the report would exceed 50 widgets, nothing is created. Errors: reporting_not_available, not_found (report), widget_not_found, nothing_to_update (empty copies), conflicting_filter, smart_view_not_found, tag_not_found, tag_type_mismatch, invalid_title, widget_limit_reached. Get ids from get_report. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// repeat a chart for two Smart Views.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","reportId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","widgetId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002","copies":[{"viewId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"},{"viewId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004","title":"Apto crédito"}]}
```

copies.description: One entry per copy to create.

name: duplicate_report_widget

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

data.description: Stored widget config: period, startDate/endDate (d-m-Y), typeMetric, previous-period dates.

filter.description: The applied filter (Smart View or tag selection), or null when the widget is unfiltered.
